title: Optimized + QoL
description: Optimized + QoL modpack, probably works on public servers. No game changing tweaks, just QoL and optimization.
body:
Optimized Modpack, with Sodium. Has shader support using Iris. Some QoL features like Xaeros Minimap, and Simple HUD Enhanced. 

If you do not like QoL features, you should use [Fabulously Optimized](https://modrinth.com/modpack/fabulously-optimized) as it is more well made, and more maintained than this modpack.
